summary: DVM and state veterinary license with 10 years of continuous small-animal and mixed-animal clinical experience. Skilled in diagnostic imaging, surgery, preventive care, and client education across growing mid-market veterinary practices.

experience.title: Lead Veterinarian
experience.employer: a growing mid-market small-animal veterinary group
bullets: Examine animals to detect and determine the nature of diseases or injuries, completing 25-35 appointments per day.
Treat sick or injured animals by prescribing medication, setting bones, dressing wounds, and performing routine and emergency surgery.
Operate diagnostic equipment such as radiographic and ultrasound equipment and interpret resulting images to guide treatment plans.
Collect body tissue, feces, blood, urine, and other body fluids for examination and analysis; review laboratory results with clients.
Inoculate animals against rabies, distemper, and other diseases, maintaining immunization records for more than 4,000 patients.
Counsel clients about euthanasia decisions and the deaths of their pets, providing compassionate end-of-life guidance.
Advise animal owners regarding sanitary measures, feeding, general care, medical conditions, and treatment options.
Educate the public about diseases that can be spread from animals to humans through community outreach and clinic seminars.
